snippet.title: Slay the Spire 2 - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
The Spire awakens once more in Steam Early Access on March 5, 2026! ⚔️

New characters, enemies, environments & more await you in Slay the Spire 2, the sequel to the iconic roguelike deckbuilder. Will you attempt the climb alone... or enlist the aid of your fellow adventurers?

⚙️ Wishlist on Steam: https://s.team/a/2868840

Looking for even more ways to get Slay the Spire 2 updates? Join the flock:
🐤 Twitter: https://twitter.com/MegaCrit
🦋 Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/megacrit.com
🎵 Tiktok: https://tiktok.com/@megacritgames
👾 Discord: https://discord.gg/slaythespire

Trailer Production:

Executive Producer :  Casey Yano
Producer :  Demi Montes
Producer :  Marlowe Dobbe
Composer :  Clark Aboud
Trailer Director/Editor/Capture Artist :  Derek Lieu
Sound Designer :  Neha Patel
Sound Mixer :  Michael Cardillo
Motion Graphics :  Josue Mancilla Ruiz
Motion Graphics :  William Eklöf

Animation by WIZZ:

Director :  Florent Remize @flomize 
Creative Director : CRCR studio @crcrstudio (as Gary Levesque, Paul Lacolley & Jérémy Pires)
Production : WIZZ @wizzdesign
Producer : Ilona Marcus
Production Manager : Sara Burgio
Scouting Manager : Julie Bellemare

Assistant Director : Anne Pulce
Storyboard Artists : Olivier Fauxpoint, Yohann Abdelnour

Character Design : Yoann Hervo
Color Script : Victor Delorme
Wizz 3D supervisor: Hugo Garnier
3D Artist : Njolai Pachomius

Background Artists : Victor Delorme, Charles Di Cicco

Lead Animation : Gaelle Thierry
Animation : Loup Bouchet, Charlotte Hubert, Zoe Palasie, Roman Guillanton, Pacôme Noblet

Editor :  Anne Pulce and Marius Corroler

Technical Director : Hadrien Farre
IT : Nicolas Biardeau, Emmanuel Zangzang
